title: Tables made by the compiler

milestone.title: Visual Studio and the Build Pipeline

description:
Build lookup tables at compile time with `constexpr`.

```
sine table of 256 entries built at compile time
sin(64) = 1.000 (90 degrees)
gamma table: 128 -> 56
static_assert checks passed
```
hints: `x - x³/6 + x⁵/120 - x⁷/5040 + x⁹/362880` is accurate enough between -π and π (lesson 4.10).
requirements: A `constexpr` function that fills a `std::array<float, 256>` (use a Taylor series, since `std::sin` may not be `constexpr`).
`static_assert` a few values so mistakes fail the build.
stretch: Compare the speed of the table with `std::sin` in a release build.
